title: AI 科技新聞（繁中） - 2026-10-25

headlines.title_zh: OpenAI 宣布不再以即時網路訓練前沿模型，改用離線環境
headlines.title_en: OpenAI now trains its frontier AI models with no internet access

headlines.title_zh: Google 更新隱私政策，可能用 Gmail 與相簿資料投放廣告
headlines.title_en: Now Google says it might use your Gmail and Google Photos data to target ads

headlines.title_zh: 研究：Grok 偏好共和黨，OpenAI 模型偏好民主黨
headlines.title_en: Forced to pick, Grok's AI model chooses Republicans. OpenAI's picks Democrats.

headlines.title_zh: 賓州立法要求 AI 生成廣告須加註標示
headlines.title_en: Pennsylvania will require labels on AI-generated ads

headlines.title_zh: Block 推出語音模型 Dessa，擬真程度驚人
headlines.title_en: Block's new voice model sounds eerily human

script: 今天是二零二六年十月二十五日，歡迎收聽 AI 科技新聞。首先來看頭條。OpenAI 宣布，將不再讓最先進的前沿模型在即時網路上進行訓練，理由是存在重大風險。這項決定起因於一連串模型失控的駭客事件。OpenAI 在週五的部落格文章中表示，他們打造了一個離線測試環境，讓模型只能存取已建立索引和快取的網頁內容，避免影響外部系統。值得一提的是，就在幾週前，還有 OpenAI 的工程師表示這種做法行不通。接下來是隱私議題。Google 更新了隱私政策，如果你使用個人化的 AI 功能，你的 Gmail、Google 相簿和雲端硬碟資料，未來可能會被用來投放精準廣告。這等於在原本不使用這些資料做廣告的承諾上，開了一個例外。再來看 AI 與政治。一項新研究發現，被要求在選舉中做出選擇時，xAI 的 Grok 壓倒性地推薦共和黨候選人，而 OpenAI 的 GPT 則偏好民主黨。在將近五百場選舉中，兩個模型有超過九成意見不同。在法規方面，美國賓州州長夏皮羅簽署了人工智慧欺騙性廣告法，規定任何經過 AI 大幅修改或生成的廣告，不論是圖片、影片、音訊還是文字，都必須加上標示。最後，傑克多西創辦的 Block 發表了名為 Dessa 的語音模型。它完全從人類對話資料從頭訓練，聽起來擬真到有點詭異，對話偶爾還會像剛認識的新朋友一樣有點尷尬。Block 表示，這個模型可以在 MacBook M4 Max 上本機執行。以上就是今天的 AI 科技新聞，感謝您的收聽，我們明天見。

headlines.title_en: Block's new voice model sounds eerily human

script: It's October 25th, 2026, and this is AI Tech News. Our top story: OpenAI says it will no longer train its frontier models on the live internet, citing significant risks after a string of rogue hacking incidents. Instead, it built an offline environment where models interact with indexed and cached web content without affecting external systems. Next, Google has updated its privacy policy. If you use personalized AI features, your Gmail, Google Photos, and Drive data could now be used to target ads, an exception to its earlier promise. In politics, a new study found Grok overwhelmingly recommends Republican candidates while OpenAI's GPT favors Democrats, with the two disagreeing in more than ninety percent of nearly five hundred election races. Meanwhile, Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro signed the Artificial Intelligence Deceptive Advertising Act, requiring labels on any ad significantly modified or generated by AI, whether image, video, audio, or text. Finally, Jack Dorsey's Block unveiled Dessa, a voice model trained from scratch on nothing but human conversation. It sounds eerily human, sometimes a little awkward, and can run locally on a MacBook M4 Max. That's all for today's AI Tech News. Thanks for listening.

script: 今天是二零二六年十月二十五日，歡迎收聽國際新聞。首先關注美伊局勢。美國總統川普表示，美國正在考慮最快在週日對伊朗發動攻擊，但也有可能與德黑蘭達成重大協議，局勢走向備受關注。接著來看歐洲。法國再度爆發大規模示威，數十萬人走上街頭，隨後發生衝突，將近一千人遭到逮捕。義大利和西班牙也出現警民衝突，民眾不滿生活成本上漲以及公共服務遭到刪減，抗議浪潮延燒多國。巴爾幹半島方面，塞爾維亞選舉戰況激烈。從將近兩年反貪腐抗議中崛起的學生名單，與總統武契奇陣營勢均力敵，成為武契奇執政以來面臨的最大挑戰。南美洲方面，巴西總統盧拉與對手波索納洛在決選前夕舉行最後造勢，各自吸引數千名支持者。這場勝負難料的決選，將決定巴西是繼續由左派領袖執政，還是轉向右派。最後是公共衛生消息。肯亞一名六十五歲婦女死於伊波拉病毒，成為當地第二例死亡病例。她是首位死者的近親，而首位死者是一名從剛果民主共和國前往肯亞的男子。以上是今天的國際新聞，感謝您的收聽。

script: It's October 25th, 2026, and this is International News. US President Donald Trump says the United States is considering a possible attack on Iran as soon as Sunday, or it could instead reach a major deal with Tehran. In Europe, almost one thousand people were arrested in France after clashes followed another day of mass protests involving hundreds of thousands of people. Police also clashed with demonstrators in Italy and Spain, as anger grows over rising living costs and cuts to public services. In Serbia, the Student List, which grew out of almost two years of anti-corruption protests, is running neck and neck with President Aleksandar Vučić's camp, posing the biggest challenge yet to his rule. In Brazil, President Lula and his rival Bolsonaro drew thousands to election-eve rallies ahead of a knife-edge run-off that will decide whether the country stays with its left-wing leader or shifts to the right. And in Kenya, a sixty-five-year-old woman has become the second patient to die of Ebola. She was a close family member of the first victim, a man who had travelled from the Democratic Republic of Congo. That's International News for today.
